tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand the Medizinische Wissensdatenbank — a PostgreSQL-based knowledge management system for medical content with local AI-powered extraction.

tour.title: Application Entry Point
tour.description: The FastAPI backend boots here. main.py sets up CORS, includes all routers, and manages the application lifespan (starting the source watcher on startup).

tour.title: API Routers — REST Endpoints
tour.description: All REST endpoints are defined in api/routers/. Each router handles a specific domain: auth, entries CRUD, search, classifications, file management, and the AI pipeline.

tour.title: Data Models & Database
tour.description: Pydantic models define the API contract, while SQLAlchemy models and PostgreSQL schema define the persistence layer. The schema uses pgvector for embeddings and tsvector for full-text search.

tour.title: AI Processing Pipeline
tour.description: The pipeline processes uploaded files through OCR (Tesseract), transcription (Whisper.cpp), classification (Llamaserver), and embedding generation. The orchestrator coordinates the workflow.

tour.title: Search Implementations
tour.description: Three search strategies: full-text search (tsvector + pg_trgm), faceted navigation via materialized views, and hybrid search combining FTS with vector similarity.

tour.title: Frontend — SvelteKit
tour.description: The SvelteKit frontend provides the user interface with routes for dashboard, search, entry creation (with KI upload), entry detail/edit, settings, and admin sync monitoring.

tour.title: Services & File Sync
tour.description: Background services handle file synchronization with the database, source folder monitoring via watchdog, and batch import job management.

tour.title: Configuration & Deployment
tour.description: Configuration is managed through YAML source definitions, pyproject.toml, and environment variables. Docker Compose runs PostgreSQL + pgvector, and start.sh orchestrates all services.
